comment: Byte ceilings for what a COLD load pays before any route code runs. Raise a limit only with a measurement in the PR that explains what the bytes buy.

apps/app.comment: Entry chunk + transitive STATIC imports + entry CSS. Lazy route chunks are excluded: they are paid on navigation, not on boot. Includes the route loader that resolves the shell's opening decision before first paint — it costs ~4.6 KB gzip and removes three full-viewport paints from a cold load, which is a trade worth making explicitly. React, React Router and Zod are split into vendor chunks: that costs ~600 B gzip in boundary overhead and buys cache stability, since an edit under lib/api used to invalidate React Router for every returning reader.
